faq.a: Artur is associated with the Latin form أَرْتُور, whose core sense is artur; arthur (european form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Artur?
faq.a: Artur is associated with Latin. Artur is a European male given name, a form of Arthur. It is used among Muslims in the Caucasus and Central Asia.
No — the underlying form is Latin, not Arabic.
Artur can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Latin-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Artur should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Artur is a European name, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.q: What does Artur mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Artur is rendered ارتور and carries the sense ارتور، آرتھر.

faq.q: What does Artur mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Artur is rendered آرتور and carries the sense آرتور، آرتور.
A romanized syllable approximation is ar-tur. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Artur?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Artur, artur. Script forms are آرتور, أَرْتُور, ارتور, अर्तुर.

faq.q: Is Artur a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
